zebra-api conclusion: rate limiting uses a sliding window of ninety seconds per caller identity.
billing decision: proration credits apply at invoice finalization, never at subscription change time.
billing note: tax calculation for australian customers uses the gst inclusive ledger path.
deploy-infra runbook: canary rollout aborts automatically when error budget burn exceeds two percent.
deploy-infra postmortem: the dns outage came from terraform destroying the private zone during autoscaler cleanup.

ml-pipeline capacity: training jobs need four gpus with gradient checkpoint sharding enabled.
